stories.title: Two-vehicle collision closed A494 at Ewloe for 2 hours overnight
stories.summary: The A494 at Ewloe was closed for around two hours overnight after a two-vehicle collision on the eastbound carriageway. North Wales Police said officers were called just before 12.30am on Monday 17 August. stories.summary: Smoking and vaping are banned across Chester Zoo and its nature reserve from today, with the zoo pointing to dry conditions and the risk of wildfire. stories.title: North Wales Police appeal for witnesses to Holywell car arson
stories.summary: North Wales Police are appealing for witnesses after a car was deliberately set alight on a residential street in Holywell.
